cases.source_text:
(actor clock_domain_event_crossing
  (clock-domains
    (domain source (clock bus_clk) (reset bus_rst_n) :default)
    (domain core (clock core_clk) (reset core_rst_n)))
  (crossings
    (event byte_ready
      (from source byte_ready_req)
      (to core byte_ready_pulse)
      (ready byte_ready_ready)))
  (interface
    (input bus_start (domain source))
    (output core_seen (domain core)))
  (transaction bus_capture
    (domain source)
    (on bus_start)
    (await byte_ready_ready)
    (complete byte_ready_req))
  (transaction core_consume
    (domain core)
    (on byte_ready_pulse)
    (complete core_seen)))

artifacts.clock_domain_event_crossing__domain_sour:
(?fsm:clock_domain_event_crossing__domain_source

  (+system
    (clock bus_clk)
    (sreset bus_rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+size
    (bus_start 1)
    (byte_ready_ready 1)
    (byte_ready_req 1)
    (bus_capture_wd 16)
    (can_accept 1)
    (last_error 1)
  )

  (bus_capture_idle_0
    (= (can_accept 1))
    (<= (bus_capture_wd (- 65535 1)))
    (<bus_start
      (-> bus_capture_await_1)
    )
  )

  (bus_capture_await_1
    (<byte_ready_ready
      (-> bus_capture_done_2)
    )
    (?bus_capture_wd
      (=0 (-> bus_capture_timeout))
      (>0 (-- bus_capture_wd))
    )
  )

  (bus_capture_done_2
    (<1 (byte_ready_req> 1))
    (-> bus_capture_idle_0)
  )

  (bus_capture_timeout
    (<1 (done 1))
    (<- (last_error 1))
    (-> bus_capture_idle_0)
  )

)

(?fsm:single_unused

  (+system
    (clock clk)
    (sreset rst_n active_low)
  )

  (+interface
    (input start)
    (input spare_bus)
  )

    (start 1)
    (spare_bus 9)
